scenes.summary: With Perlica and Fiona's help, you decide to use the Protocol Singularity to follow Laevatain's trail left across Valley IV and enter the Protocol Space where she is.

lines.text: Endmin, you're back.
Please keep Laevatain safe and bring her back here. Most importantly ... make sure you return safely as well, Endmin.
Finding Laevatain in the Protocol Space is ... theoretically feasible, but risky too. Your physical condition ... has got me a little concerned...
Understood. Fiona and I just completed a plan.
Simply put, Laevatain would have looked for a suitable rift "opening". Then, by using memories as a clue, she would have forcibly entered the matching Protocol Space.
The recent Æther activities of Valley IV gave her an opportunity. This is why she got in touch with you, Endmin.
We can use the same method ... with the Protocol Singularity and your abilities. By following traces of Laevatain's Originium reactions, you can locate the Protocol Space she went to.
Yes. Both the Protocol Space and reconveners are somehow related to you. Your thorough search is definitely going to help us locate her.
Endmin! We finished analyzing the parameters of Laevatain's Originium reactions. You're good to go, anytime!

options: We made a promise about memories.

scenes.summary: Laevatain and you meet in the Protocol Space. Together, you start your memory-searching journey.

lines.text: You're here ... Endmin. Didn't keep me waiting for too long.
It's nothing. Just walked a long way before coming here.
Let's go. I don't think we should stay here.
Found nothing so far. But that wouldn't stop me. What about you?
Hmph. Then we should make good on our promise, and start our memory search together.
Then it's a deal.

options: Nothing for me either. That's why I'm here.
And I promise to find the truth in your memories.

scenes.summary: The illusion of Laevatain suddenly appears in the room and doubts if Laevatain could ever find her raison d'être from her memories. However, Laevatain does not intend to give up like this.

lines.text: What is this place...?
"Home"... A place welcoming you back, even when you've forgotten about it...
But I found none of this in my memories...
Awww, poor Endmin, forced to tag along with your shenanigans.
After all this diving in the Protocol Space, you still ended up with nothing.
Don't you understand, Laevatain? Your happiness is false. Your hatred is false. Even the thing you've been searching for ... is false.
This is why you'll never find "home" — you're just an empty shell, a pretty husk without a soul!
An empty shell...?
The past of Surtr ... isn't your concern.
{F}Laevatain! Are you alright?{M}Laevatain! Are you alright?
I've never opposed you. You're the one who keeps hurting yourself. I'm only trying to protect you — what you're seeking will destroy you.
Since you started doubting who you are and longing for your memories, I have existed.
You'll never find something that you *never* owned. Such is your fate. You can only abandon your self, and live on as a mere tool.
Give up. Why not stop resisting and just take one of these fragments ... and treat it as yours?
What a load of ... crock... Give up? Pfft...
Well then, let's see what you can walk away with ... after you reach Surtr's "home".
Since you insist so stubbornly and foolishly, I'll let you take the path of self-destruction. Go to Kazdel. Go to her home.
Then it's time to reclaim my memories!
Why? Why are you ... going against me?

scenes.summary: Laevatain feels the existence of Surtr's "home" and rushes forth without thinking.

lines.text: Tsk... This is slowing me down...
Even if this is going to take my life, nothing's more important than finding the truth in my memories.
I can sense the whereabouts of Surtr's "home". It's close.
But time's running out... I gotta act quickly.
{F}Wait!{M}Wait!

scenes.summary: Laevatain has reached the end of her memories, but she failed to find out who she was from "home". You give hope to Laevatain who is on the brink of breaking down. Together, you follow Surtr's "answer" and press forward.

lines.text: You ... found me.
I arrived at Surtr's "home" but...
I only saw a girl whose name has been lost...
A refugee escaping the fires of war...
A hand stinging and burning from the scorching heat...
A family and home in the dust that I do not recognize ... and many other things...
I have seen every memory fragment of this place... But found nothing... None of them can tell me "who I am"...
I want to keep going ... but ... where else could I go...?
I don't want to live out my life ... as an empty shell...
{F}No. You are not an empty shell.{M}No. You are not an empty shell.
{F}I bear witness to your existence.{M}I bear witness to your existence.
My ... existence?
{F}You are my companion — you ended my confusion and taught me to see through falsehoods...{M}You are my companion — you ended my confusion and taught me to see through falsehoods...
{F}I remember your name, your fire, and your pursuit for the truth...{M}I remember your name, your fire, and your pursuit for the truth...
{F}All these belong to Laevatain and no one else.{M}All these belong to Laevatain and no one else.
But isn't this "search for memories" the sole reason I exist?
{F}No. It's "self-discovery" that gives you meaning.{M}No. It's "self-discovery" that gives you meaning.
{F}And I can help you. Do not give up.{M}And I can help you. Do not give up.
You consumed yourself ... to stabilize my existence... Why? You've just awakened, and you're fighting a powerful enemy...
{F}Because I promised to help you recover your memories.{M}Because I promised to help you recover your memories.
{F}And helping another Chief Amnesiac like me ... goes without saying.{M}And helping another Chief Amnesiac like me ... goes without saying.
This is ... Surtr's "answer"...
{F}Let's take it.{M}Let's take it.

scenes.summary: You and Laevatain witness Surtr's final "answer" — she finally left her past memories behind and treated Rhodes Island as "home". You hope to use the same approach to solve Laevatain's dilemma and invite her to Endfield Industries.

lines.text: Surtr.../Laevatain...
Congratulations on your first anniversary at Rhodes Island! Do you like it here?
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator B}

lines.text: Rhodes Island is your home. And we prepped three crates of ice cream that can be claimed at the Procurement Department. There won't be any field operations this week. So, enjoy your break.
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

lines.text: We know you like the thrill of freedom, so we got you a skateboard as a gift!
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator B}

lines.text: A special lava slug bloodbrew cocktail — super cooled with liquid nitrogen! Don't worry, it's safe. No crazy chemical reagents were added this time ... I think.
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator D}

lines.text: Interested in an after-party at One More Shot? Or enjoy the fresh air on the top deck?
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator C}

lines.text: This place is my home. So why should I obsess about finding the last one I had?
This album is an anthology of all the operations we did together! If you have trouble finding your past, just know that everyone's here for your future.
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

lines.text: It seems that people without a past ... can also choose to live in the present.
If I saw this at the moment of my awakening, would I choose a different path...?
{F}It's a shame ... but it also gave you the freedom of choice.{M}It's a shame ... but it also gave you the freedom of choice.
{F}You get to choose how to go "beyond" the memories.{M}You get to choose how to go "beyond" the memories.
Choice...
She chose to love Rhodes Island as "home".
I think I understand that sensation. A noisy place filled with hassles, but it's also warm and ... interesting.
That's why she gave up ... 'cause finding the past is no longer that important.
But I'm different. I haven't found the people or things to make me give up those memories.
I can't find my own "Rhodes Island" on Talos-II.
{F}Perhaps ... you can find your own Endfield?{M}Perhaps ... you can find your own Endfield?
...Making your move already? Never expected you to be the cunning type, Endmin.
{F}Only if you're willing.{M}Only if you're willing.
Hmph. I'll accept your invitation.
{F}Looks like you've sorted things out.{M}Looks like you've sorted things out.
This is just the beginning.
Whether I can free myself from this mire of memory ... will depend on what I discover at Endfield.
{F}I give you my word as Endministrator: Endfield will become your "home".{M}I give you my word as Endministrator: Endfield will become your "home".
Home...
Alright. I'll see how you make good on this promise.
Rhodes Island... A place that welcomes me home whenever I want. A place that lets me do what I want.
...So that's how you "answered" the question...

scenes.summary: Surtr's treasured memory fragment. It is about her taming of the flaming giant and how she started her journey and adventures.

lines.text: Good. You're finally behaving. Now you can say goodbye to the flaming giant you once were.
Journeys and adventures... Did she actually give up her memory-search because of these?
I don't care how many people wielded you before. I'll be the last of them.
From now on, you shall only follow one voice. Surtr's voice — my voice.
And if you dare order me around, I will annihilate you completely, with your own powers.
You're joining my journey. We'll eat good food and beat up people who have it coming.
Bend to me! Become the Envoy of the Fire!
No.
Then you will never leave!

scenes.summary: Surtr's treasured memory fragment. It is about ice cream and how deeply she cares about it.

lines.text: Ooh. You actually can feel the cold. That means more ice cream is coming your way.
All the frustrations and pain from the memories... This is how they ended in peace.
The icy cold ... the stinging sensation ... the cloying sweetness...
Ridiculous... But why is the sensation ... so comforting...
No. I just heard about their fancy ice cream machines. Gonna try them out.
Apologies, Operator Surtr. The cafeteria pantry is out of ice cream... But an emergency batch is being made right now! Just wait a minute!
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator B}

lines.text: It's okay. I can wait.
Surtr! Where's your next field operation?
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator C}

lines.text: Laterano, I think.
Are you going there to validate some memories?
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator C}

scenes.summary: Surtr's treasured memory fragment. It is about her experiences of joining Rhodes Island.

lines.text: This is when she joined Rhodes Island... She treated these memories ... with great importance.
Is there any codename you want?
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

lines.text: Just call me Surtr.
Clinical analysis has confirmed that you are infected with Oripathy.
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

lines.text: I don't know how to wield Arts.
That won't be necessary. We have a good understanding of your potential. Welcome to Rhodes Island.
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

lines.text: I just hope you won't bore me.
Don't worry. Our clauses and terms ... are not restrictive.
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

lines.text: But I can deal with all sorts of problems. Need a demo?
Cell-Originium assimilation is at 1%. No signs of infection on the surface of the body. Blood Originium-Crystal Density is at 0.10u/L, but Originium Arts Assimilation...
lines.who: Voice of a Rhodes Island Operator {c16-Rhodes Island Operator A}

scenes.summary: The remaining memory fragments refuse to be left behind. They turn hostile and try to stop you and Laevatain from leaving.

lines.text: Looks like a malicious being is remaking this maze of memories.
Memories aren't easily cast aside ... they resurface as enemies.
Be prepared to fight the past. If our minds fail to escape quickly enough, they might be trapped here forever.
Now it wants to "keep" us.

scenes.summary: Laevatain is determined to say goodbye to the rest of her memories.

lines.text: Perhaps we can treat it as our "final goodbye".
We just need to do one thing —
Sever all ties to the residues of the past, set them alight till they become ash.
{F}What's at the bottom of this...?{M}What's at the bottom of this...?
End of the maze.
And a confluence of all remaining memories.
Well then, let's make this a worthy spectacle.
Endmin, why do reconveners need another person's memories from the past...?
Then what about me? What about my memories?
That's probably a reason exclusive to me.

options: Sounds like we'll be getting quite a fight.
They need memories for the legacy and identity.
Perhaps you're meant to say "goodbye" to them.
You broke their shackles and forged a new identity.

scenes.summary: Laevatain and you return to Dijiang together. She decides to stay, become an operator, and fulfill her promise to a fellow companion. She also expects you to create memorable moments with her.

lines.text: So this is Dijiang...
Show me the places we saw in that maze.
It's quite different from Rhodes Island.
Excellent.
Yes. For a new beginning.
From now on...
I shall be Laevatain, and fulfill the promise made to my fellow companion.
I know. So you gotta make new memories for me.
I can be your operator, your sword, and your fire.
But in return, I demand a unique journey ... a unique adventure and ... a unique "home".
That will give me an Endfield of my own.
A place where I can forget about my memories.
What. That's too much for you?
{F}This place won't disappoint you, Laevatain.{M}This place won't disappoint you, Laevatain.
Neither will I disappoint you, Endmin.

options: Sure. The Bridge is over there.
But I can't start another memory search right now.

scenes.summary: An illusion of Ginny appears and it triggers a memory fragment within Laevatain's mind. Unfortunately, that fragment is not hers to begin with.

lines.text: Ginny? Is that the name of this child?
Where the wind was soft ... and the meadows were quiet... I took my naps at that place.
Hi, pretty lady. What flowers do you like? Just take them!
Come play with me! We can make colors from the petals and draw everyone!
Do you like flowers?
Petals brushed against my face, carrying a subtle fragrance.
Ironically, this is just one of the many fragments that do not belong to me.
Yet, it is also one of the very few beautiful memories carried within my mind.
So, have you seen flowers that make you happy?
That doesn't count! That place has no flowers!
No! Only scary pipefaced people live there!
Hmmm... Would you consider that your own happiness?
Don't give up! Keep looking around!
Ah ... thank you.
Flowers... I remember something ... a time when there was no fire, nor battles, nor a sword by my side.
It was the most idyllic moment I remember.

options: Memories like that should be treasured.
Yes. I saved her in Valley IV.
She likes to draw and has a gift for it.

scenes.summary: An illusion of a Landbreaker appears. Laevatain is once again confused by seeing a "memory that is not hers".

lines.text: Is this your enemy?
Enemies... My memories have plenty of enemies.
*Mumbles*
*Sigh*... Perhaps...
You! "END-MINI-STRATOR", huh? Why treat us as your enemy?
Still dreamin' about your lies? We will bury you, "SAVIOR"!
HELP?! Lies! ALL LIES! An excuse to make your forgetful self feel better!
*Mumble*! Puppet! The old world of Originium is finished! The future is in the Æther!
You... Your struggles are useless!
I'LL KILL YA!
Zip it, or I'm burning you to ash, right now.
All I felt were instilled fury, shame, frustration...

options: Bonekrushers led by Nefarith. They created a crisis.
I do so to protect Valley IV.
I'm just going with the flow...
And what were you like ... in those memories?

scenes.summary: Laevatain has been injured in her dive into the Protocol Space. However, she remains determined to locate her true memories here.

lines.text: {F}This place...{M}This place...
See anything familiar?
Then let's look around and see what they have.
I know... But an injured body is hardly a concern when compared with broken memories.
Indeed. We shall press forward together.
I never dwell on a clue that came too late. I just keep going and never turn back...
That's how I'll find my true self...
Instincts tell me that the answers I seek can be found here...

options: I think so ... but this doesn't feel right.
We'll leave this place, just like our first meeting.

scenes.summary: An illusion blocks your way. After describing Laevatain's color, you receive directions to look for her.

lines.text: She...? Tell me about her colors and shades.
There isn't anyone with that color. I only remember the spotless blue skies of Sami after snow.
Never seen that before. I only remember tender green shoots watered by snowmelt.
Oh, I know. It's her... She brought the war-like hues and walked amongst us.
Go forth and catch up to her.
What are you looking at?

options: She probably walked past this place...

scenes.summary: The illusions block your way. You share Laevatain's name and receive a new instruction. You then continue your search for her.

lines.text: And what is the name of this ... someone you're looking for?
A visitor bearing this name ... left the ruins in a hurry, and gave nothing but a sigh.
That's not her. The entity no longer belongs to this place.
I'm afraid this is the wrong place ... to learn about yourself.
Go catch up to her, but watch the deep beneath your feet.
I don't recognize you. What brings you here?

scenes.summary: You ask the illusion for Laevatain's whereabouts. When you speak about Laevatain's goals, the illusion agrees to help.

lines.text: The girl bearing fire... Why is she here?
No. She's more than willing to harm herself in her own pursuits.
That's her. And she's asking everyone if they had seen a girl with her likeness.
Think about it. She cares little about hatred. "Her identity" is what matters to her most.
Make yourself a guest at her home. But be quick. She is very exhausted.
You're finally here.

options: Do you know where Laevatain is?

scenes.summary: Illusion of Laevatain appears once more and persuades you to give up on her.

lines.text: You already know what's going to happen to Laevatain. Why risk diving into the Deep? Who is she to you?
Do not go any further.
Cease this pursuit, and don't be like Laevatain. She ignores the risks of overreaching and will get herself killed.
{F}Hmph, I will bring her out safely.{M}Hmph, I will bring her out safely.

options: A reconvener and companion beyond space and time.
A guide who helped me out of my confusion.
An oath-bound companion of our memory search.
